diagnosis: Customer experienced a two‑week outage and is asking to replay missed webhook events. According to KB-0015, events are only retained for manual replay for seven days after delivery attempts, so the requested replay period exceeds the supported window.
reply: Our webhook system retains events for manual replay for up to seven days after the delivery attempts have completed. Since your outage lasted two weeks, the events fall outside of that replay window and cannot be re‑sent. You may review any available logs or exported data from that period for reference. If you need further assistance extracting historical data, please let us know.
